text:
Mina (sec): Heads-up: nightly snapshot restores failing in staging. DecryptError in restore job: 'DecryptError: AccessDenied to CMK' :rotating_light: I see recent IAM policy changes on the backup-uploader role.

Raj (eng-sre): On it. Can you paste the log block?

Mina (sec): ```
2026-03-20T03:12:05Z restore-job[pid=123] ERROR DecryptError: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/backup-uploader/session is not authorized to use kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 (Service: KMS; Status Code: 400)
```

Lena (dbops): I pushed an RBAC tighten on the backup-uploader yesterday to remove broad S3 permissions and make the role least-privilege. Did we accidentally strip `kms:Decrypt` in the inline policy? My change included: `"Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-backups/*"]` — I tried to avoid touching KMS but could have mis-scoped the role.

Raj (eng-sre): Checking CloudTrail + org SCPs. Audit shows an SCP applied 2026-03-19T22:40:02 that blocks `kms:CreateGrant` for some roles and removes wildcard KMS permissions. The backup-uploader now lacks explicit `kms:Decrypt` allowed on the CMK resource — that matches the AccessDenied.

Theo (infra): If SCP is the root cause we need a safe remediation path. I can create a short-lived KMS grant scoped to the backup CMK and the backup-uploader principal for the next hour so restores can finish, then revoke. I'll also open a request to rollback that SCP change for the backup OU.

encops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-restore-decrypt. Link: https://redwood.incidents/inc/INC-2026-0319-restore-decrypt. Checklist: [1] create temp KMS grant, [2] update IAM role to include `kms:Decrypt` on CMK, [3] run restore smoke tests, [4] update playbook and prevent SCP pushes without verification.

Jules (support): Are production backups impacted or just staging?

Mina (sec): Looks like staging only so far — prod uses a different CMK and role. But this is a failure mode we need to harden. If SCPs roll out without smoke tests, prod could be hit.

Lena (dbops): I'll patch the backup-uploader role to explicitly allow `kms:Decrypt` for the snapshot CMK ARNs and push a microdeploy. Also adding a policy comment to avoid accidental removal.

Raj (eng-sre): I'll tail CloudTrail while Theo creates the grant. Also scheduling an automated smoke restore as soon as the grant is active: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://cipher.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:...` in a small verification job.

Theo (infra): Grant created (temporary, expires in 1 hour). Notifying restore job to retry.

Mina (sec): Restore retried, progress at 30% — monitoring.

Jules (support): Noted. I'll prepare one-line customer comms if this ever expands.

Raj (eng-sre): Smoke restore succeeded. Verified artifacts decrypt and DB import completed in staging. No further AccessDenied entries in the last 10m.

Mina (sec): Action items: 1) Theo: document KMS-grant emergency procedure + playbook steps (done as part of incident ticket) 2) Lena: add explicit `kms:Decrypt` to backup-uploader role for snapshot CMKs + add smoke test gating for SCPs 3) Raj: check audit trail and file a compliance note for the RBAC change. I'll draft a short RCA and a playbook update.

Lena (dbops): Will add smoke gating and a policy template for backups.

Raj (eng-sre): Putting a temporary hold on SCP rollouts for Backup OU until we have automated restore verification in CI.

Mina (sec): Thanks all. Follow-up doc + incident notes in INC-2026-0319-restore-decrypt. :white_check_mark:
